training_and_evaluation_records.evaluation_scope_note: Temporal holdout within cam_5 (train: 0-350, test: 351-600). NOT an independent camera evaluation across the 20 camera scenes.
training_and_evaluation_records.pipeline_tuning_disclosure: Geometric reference endpoints (e.g. Approach 2 exit at 45, 370) and tracking thresholds (90px boundary exit, 35px min travel distance) were calibrated after visual inspection of frames 339, 343, 359, 375, 425 across the clip. Therefore, zero-leakage cannot be claimed for the full pipeline, only for the ML feature classifier weights.
training_and_evaluation_records.rationale: On temporal holdout evaluation (frames 351-600), Baseline Heuristic achieved 89.13% movement accuracy (vs 86.96% for train-only ML) and equal F1 score (0.8200) with superior zero-shot generalization on rare and unseen classes (Movements 7 and 10).
